instruction: Summarize the repository activity in one or two sentences.
input: This week the team merged 14 pull requests across the auth and billing services. The auth service migrated its session store from cookies to signed JWTs, closing three long-standing security issues. The billing service added retry logic for failed webhook deliveries and fixed a rounding bug in invoice totals. Two contributors also updated the onboarding docs and added a new CI job that runs integration tests against a staging database on every merge to main.
gold: auth service migrated to signed JWTs
billing service added webhook retry logic
billing service fixed an invoice rounding bug

instruction: Summarize the incident report in one or two sentences.
input: At 03:14 UTC the payments API began returning elevated 500 error rates after a database connection pool exhaustion. On-call was paged automatically and identified a recent deploy that removed a connection timeout as the root cause. The team rolled back the deploy at 03:41 UTC and error rates returned to baseline by 03:50 UTC. A follow-up ticket was filed to add a canary stage before future deploys touching connection pooling.
gold: payments API had elevated 500 errors from connection pool exhaustion
root cause was a deploy that removed a connection timeout
team rolled back the deploy and errors returned to baseline

instruction: Summarize the product update email in one or two sentences.
input: We're excited to announce two changes shipping this week. First, exporting reports to PDF is now available on all paid plans, not just Enterprise. Second, we've reduced average dashboard load time by 40% by moving chart rendering to a background worker. Both changes are live now with no action required from you. As always, reach out to support with any questions.
gold: PDF export is now available on all paid plans
dashboard load time was reduced by about 40%

instruction: Summarize the meeting notes in one or two sentences.
input: The design review covered the new onboarding flow. The team agreed to cut the signup form from seven fields to three, deferring company size and use-case questions to a post-signup survey. There was disagreement about whether to require email verification before first login; the decision was deferred to next week pending data from the growth team on drop-off rates.
gold: signup form was cut from seven fields to three
email verification requirement decision was deferred pending growth data

instruction: Summarize the customer feedback thread in one or two sentences.
input: Several customers on the community forum reported that the mobile app's search feature returns stale results after switching workspaces. One user posted a workaround of force-closing the app, which several others confirmed worked. The mobile team acknowledged the bug and said a fix is targeted for the next release, expected in two weeks.
gold: mobile app search returns stale results after switching workspaces
mobile team is targeting a fix for the next release in two weeks

instruction: Summarize the release notes in one or two sentences.
input: Version 4.2 adds bulk editing for tags across up to 500 items at once, fixes a memory leak in the real-time collaboration cursor rendering that could slow down long sessions, and upgrades the underlying database driver for a modest latency improvement on read-heavy workloads. No breaking API changes are included in this release.
gold: version 4.2 adds bulk tag editing for up to 500 items
fixed a memory leak in real-time collaboration cursor rendering

instruction: Summarize the postmortem summary in one or two sentences.
input: A misconfigured feature flag caused 8% of users to see a blank checkout page for roughly 25 minutes on Tuesday afternoon. The flag was intended for an internal test cohort but was accidentally enabled globally during a routine config sync. The team added a staging-only gate for feature flag changes and a Slack alert that fires whenever a flag's rollout percentage changes by more than 10 points in under a minute.
gold: misconfigured feature flag caused a blank checkout page for about 25 minutes
team added a staging-only gate for feature flag changes

instruction: Summarize the changelog digest in one or two sentences.
input: This sprint the team shipped keyboard shortcuts for the command bar, including cmd-k to focus and escape to clear, and added support for dropping files directly onto the bar to attach them to a run. A long-standing bug where the trace panel would flicker on slow connections was also fixed by debouncing incoming SSE events.
gold: shipped keyboard shortcuts for the command bar
fixed trace panel flicker by debouncing SSE events
